verdict.rationale: Marqeta documents a programmatic disputes API: the `/cases` endpoint creates and manages dispute cases with type-specific details. It is documented only for the Mastercard network. The pack never ties its general webhooks to dispute status, and it is silent on reason codes, evidence submission and provisional credit. Missing for 10: network reason code handling, evidence/document submission, provisional credit handling, dispute-specific status webhooks through resolution, coverage beyond Mastercard, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an ops user, I can file and track disputes on card transactions programmatically — network reason codes, evidence submission, provisional credit handling, and status webhooks through resolution

citations.quote: Use the `/cases` endpoint to manage transaction disputes on the Mastercard network.
Create a new dispute case by specifying the type and including the type-specific details object.
